about: Ready-made test binders. List cards by number; one of each card per binder (DUEL-14). Put a card's number in "originals" to mark that copy as an original. These two are placeholders: both hold all 12 cards with drafted force faces plus 18 others, 30 cards each.

binders.name: Test binder A
binders.note: Placeholder. The 12 cards with force faces, plus 16 commons and 2 uncommons.

binders.name: Test binder B
binders.note: Placeholder. The 12 cards with force faces, plus 16 different commons and 2 different uncommons.
